3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The aides quickly readied a side room for us. We stepped in and sat across from one another.

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "I will be direct. Are you going to support Lespia stealing our share in the MITZ?"

12.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
12.text: "I warned you that the Lespians were a menace to the Trade Zone. You didn't listen to me, and this is your reward."

13.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
13.text: "In the end, it is Morella's decision, not mine. I am obligated to support any nationalization plan that Saltana puts forward."

17.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
17.text: "And even if I wasn't... your kingdom is arguably a greater threat than Lespia at this point."

18.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
18.text: "I am sorry. But that's the way it has to be."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Chancellor Hegel, I must insist that you do not vote for the latest proposal. It was amended without Rizia's knowledge."

23.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
23.text: "Obviously, I am against Alvarez and his cronies snapping up a bigger share of South Merkopa's largest gold resource."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Just out of curiosity, how are you planning on voting today?"

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "I know you are helping Saltana stoke internal rebellion in my kingdom. I just wanted to tell you that I don't care."
25.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == false)

26.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
26.text: "If I knew where she was, why the hell would I tell you?"

27.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
27.text: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras fled Rizia to escape the archaic marriage bond being forced upon her by her father."

31.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
31.text: "Don't worry. The chances of the new proposal passing are roughly that of a snowball in hell."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "Do you know where my daughter is?"

33.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
33.text: "But you, Mr. Toras, are arguably a greater threat than Alvarez at this point."

40.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
40.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == false) == false

41.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
41.text: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras was being kept in a golden cage -- allowed neither power nor the ability to choose her own husband."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "You and the Morellan prime minister must cease your provocations at once. The last thing any of us wants is bloodshed."
42.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == false)

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "You're still planning on voting the same way, right?"

45.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
45.text: "Why are you asking me? You'll find out in five minutes, anyway."

49.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
49.text: "Don't worry, Mr. Toras. Everything will go exactly as planned."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Good. That's all I wanted to know."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "What will it take for you to give me some extra reassurance?"

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Good point. Let's head to the vote."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "If your mind has changed... what will it take to change it back?"

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Do not disrespect the King of Rizia, Chancellor. I am warning you."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Please. There must be something Rizia can offer you."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Is there anything I can do in exchange for a little extra reassurance?"

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "How can you say that? I thought the West was your greatest nemesis."

60.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
60.text: "It is not the West that we in Valgsland are fighting, Mr. Toras. It is the boot on the necks of the oppressed everywhere."

64.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
64.text: "And with your insistence on waging an unjust war, Rizia is wearing the biggest boot of all."

65.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
65.text: "And with your violent actions in Zille, Rizia is wearing the biggest boot of all."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "A pity. But I understand. I will not try to change your mind."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "That's great to know. Let's head to the vote, then."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "So you're saying there's no chance. Zero."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: He gave a curt nod. We left the room.

71.speaker: Narrator
71.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == false)

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: He gestured to the door, and we left the room.

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: He continued to wear an inscrutable expression.

76.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
76.text: "Let's get this over with, shall we?"

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "You don't understand. There have been extenuating circumstances."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "And you? How much damage have you caused by encouraging societies to rip each other apart in the name of your 'revolution'?"

84.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
84.text: "A muscle must tear before it can grow stronger."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Please. Isn't there anything my kingdom can do to sway your vote?"

87.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
87.text: "Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you're talking about."

88.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
88.text: "Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you're talking about."

92.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
92.text: "With your campaign of terror, you are sowing the seeds for your kingdom's own demise."

93.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
93.text: "But I am glad that you have accepted the inevitability of revolution. All kingdoms must, in time."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "It's all in the service of reforms that will transform Rizia. You'll see."

98.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
98.text: "All I see is a deranged bull, charging at the people in the stands instead of the man waving the flag."

99.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
99.text: "Your monarchy has sown the seeds of its own revolution. They did not need our help to sprout."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Stop lying. You've been plotting the downfall of Rizia since you lost Pales."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "Help me quell this threat, and we will defeat the West together."

102.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
102.text: "You, King Romus Toras, want to defeat the West?"

109.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
109.text: "You expect me to believe that after you sold your island to ATO?"
109.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true)

110.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
110.text: "I see no use in speaking to you further."

111.speaker: Narrator
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false)

112.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
112.text: "If you are serious about that, there is precisely one thing you can offer."

113.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
113.text: "There is precisely one thing you can offer."

114.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
114.text: "Your island, Caleqabiz. Allow Valgsland and the CSP to use it as a base of operations."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "You are a pragmatic man, Mr. Hegel. You know that world leaders do not have to agree on everything to help each other out."

120.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
120.text: "You and I do not even agree on what constitutes basic decency."

121.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
121.text: "We will suffer through today. And then our paths will not cross again."

125.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
125.text: "You have sold your kingdom out to Lespia and ATO. No offer under the sun would convince me."
125.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true)

134.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
134.text: "Good, as it happens. Valgsland gained a new ally recently."

135.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
135.text: "I didn't come here for small talk, Mr. Toras."

136.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
136.text: "Now you want to make a deal?"

137.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
137.text: "You and your crown of stolen gold... They are coming for it, Mr. Toras."

138.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
138.text: "You don't need it. You can rely on my cooperation."

139.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
139.text: "But if it's a closer bond with Valgsland you want, I do have one offer for you..."

147.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
147.text: "You sold your own island to Lespia and ATO. No offer under the sun would convince me."
147.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == false) == false)

148.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
148.text: "Entirely out of the goodness of your heart."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "You're insane. No amount of money is worth that much."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "Fine. If that's what it will take, Caleqabiz will be yours." [+4 Budget]

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "My kingdom's claim to the Aureus gas field rests on the resource's proximity to Caleqabiz. I will not weaken it."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Our kingdom could use the extra income. Why not? Let's make a deal." [+4 Budget]

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "The CSP already has its hooks in Morella. Now you want to position yourselves on our other side? Never."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Only if you call me 'Comrade Romus'." [+4 Budget]

168.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
168.text: "A pleasure cooperating with you, Mr. Toras."

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: He reached out and shook my hand firmly.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: He reached out and shook my hand firmly.

175.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
175.text: "That was my idea. I don't have any others."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "Do you know where my daughter is?"

183.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
183.text: "If I knew where she was, why the hell would I tell you?"

184.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
184.text: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras fled Rizia to escape the archaic marriage bond being forced upon her by her father."

188.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
188.text: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras was being kept in a golden cage -- allowed neither the ability to advance her career nor choose her own life partner."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "I want the truth. Is Valgsland aiding the new revolutionary movement in Rizia?"

198.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
198.text: "Revolutions cannot be started from the outside, Mr. Toras. Your people planted the seeds of their own liberation."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "We discussed this. You yourself said the time would be right someday."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Seeds don't grow without nourishment. You've been watering them from afar."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "I want those seeds to sprout as much as you do. I am working with this movement, not against it."

208.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
208.text: "I am skeptical that even an 'enlightened' monarch such as yourself would be willing to hand the reins of government to the working class."

209.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
209.text: "But I'm ready to be positively surprised."

214.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
214.text: "Did I? I don't recall. It was very late at night."

215.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
215.text: "But I am happy to see that your politician -- Sotelato, was it? -- has finally put the Rizian working class on a path to self-determination."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "If your government is meddling with my kingdom's affairs in any way, you will pay."

221.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
221.text: "But if the time were ever right for revolution in your country, it would be now, after you dissolved your father's sad attempt at a parliament."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "Drop the high-and-mighty act, Chancellor. The CSP would love a bigger foothold in South Merkopa."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "No. I heard you might be changing your vote today?"

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "Yes. Let's get this board vote over with."

228.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
228.text: "As have you, from what I gather."

232.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
232.text: "Rizia would have much to gain from that as well, you know."

236.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
236.text: "I don't have the time or inclination to listen to your accusations. We've got a vote to sit through."
236.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_CommieKing"] == true) == false)

237.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
237.text: "I only hope that whenever your new government comes to fruition, it has the sense to reverse that decision. Until then, I don't have a thing to say to you."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "We once spoke of big changes coming to Rizia. I believe the time is now right for them."
238.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hegel_OpenToRevolution"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == true))

241.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
241.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hegel_OpenToRevolution"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == true)) == false

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: The hint of a smile appeared on his face.

248.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
248.text: "Although I am worried that without the workers' movement leading the charge, the 'new' Rizia will suspiciously resemble the old one."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "You don't need to worry about that. Just know that we'll be open to closer ties with Valgsland going forward."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "I assure you these changes are being made with the working class in mind."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "That is the least of my concerns. I'll be lucky to pass even a bare-bones version of reform."

252.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
252.text: "If it's closer ties with Valgsland you want, there is something I can offer you right away."

257.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
257.text: "You are the monarch, are you not? Exercise your power while you still can."

258.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
258.text: "How can you say that when your most strategic island has been leased to our ideological rival?"

264.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
264.text: "While you are still monarch of Rizia, there is one thing I would ask of you."

267.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
267.text: "I would take you to task for leasing your most strategic island to our direct rivals in Lespia. But I'll save that conversation for your predecessor, whoever he or she may be."
